correctness.rationale: Every normalized 1-cocycle over arbitrary abelian A is determined by root/row/column/mixed triangles; opposite-corner constraints give H^1=A^2, A, or A[2]. Explicit integer or 2-torsion generators satisfy all triangles, establishing sufficiency. The connected-complex universal coefficient theorem and finite generation force integral H1=Z^2, Z, or Z/2. A standard-library verifier exhaustively checks seven finite boards including the cocycle formulas and mod-prime ranks; Smith normal form independently corroborates three cases. Finite checks are never used to infer infinitely many parameters.

broader_coverage.reasoning: A complete all-board high-dimensional neighborhood homology formula concerns H_k for k>=3 and a relative cofiber, not H1; it does not determine the low-dimensional connecting homomorphism. Matsushita supplies a general fundamental-group framework but no explicit rectangular family integral H1. Shukla studies maximum degree <=3 and selected four-regular circulants; rectangular rook graphs generally have degree m+n-2>=5. No stronger full integral H1 classification was found.
